title: Ferhenga Pirzimanî – Kurdish Multilingual Lexicon: dictionary, reference grammar and etymology
description: Open lexical database of Kurdish varieties (Kurmanji, Sorani, Southern Kurdish, Zazaki, Gorani) derived from Wiktionary, with UPOS, UD/UniMorph features, inflected forms, verb paradigms, etymology classes, Turkish/English/German translations, a CLDF Dictionary export and a descriptive Kurmanji reference grammar with Leipzig-glossed examples. Not yet expert-reviewed.
